name: popsicle
headline: Social Media Automation: AI Posting & Scheduling
short_description: Social Media Automation é uma solução de automação para redes sociais que utiliza Node.js, Playwright, Redis e n8n para criar fluxos inteligentes com IA, permitindo gerar, agendar e publicar conteúdos automaticamente de forma eficiente e escalável.
author: aasmaagh

sections.overview:
Social Media Automation is a Node.js-based tool that streamlines content publishing across social platforms like LinkedIn. It uses Playwright for browser automation, Redis for data management, and n8n to build intelligent workflows. The skill enables you to generate engaging content with AI, schedule posts across multiple platforms, and monitor performance metrics in real-time. Teams managing large volumes of social content benefit from scalable, hands-off posting without manual intervention.
Schedule LinkedIn posts across multiple accounts automatically
Generate AI-tailored content for different audience segments
Monitor post performance and engagement metrics in real-time
Manage high-volume posting workflows without manual intervention
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/aasmaagh/social-media-automation`
sections.usage:
```
I need to automate my social media content for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Create a workflow using Node.js, Playwright, Redis, and n8n that can generate, schedule, and publish posts automatically. The content should be tailored to [TARGET_AUDIENCE] and include [SPECIFIC_CONTENT_TYPES] like images, videos, and text. Ensure the system can handle [POSTING_FREQUENCY] posts per day.
```
